content: If the optional TcpIpDuplicateAddressDetectionConfig is defined and a duplicate IP address was found by the Duplicate Address Detection (DAD) algorithm, the TcpIp shall call the callout function specified by TcpIpDuplicateAddressDetectionCalloutName.
